ai.title: Liwan AI
ai.prompt: How can I help with your work today?
ai.note: It only suggests and explains; it never approves or sends anything for you. Your system administrator sees what the assistant does, never the text of your conversations.

starters.label: Questions to start with
starters.overdue: Which of my tasks are overdue?
starters.projects: How are my active projects doing?
starters.week: What do I have this week?

followUps.label: Follow-up questions
followUps.risks: Is there anything that needs attention?
followUps.projectTasks: Which of its tasks are overdue?
followUps.projectNext: What is the next step in this project?
followUps.taskNext: What is the next step for it?
followUps.taskRelated: Which tasks are related to it?
followUps.financeNext: What in finance needs my follow-up?

composer.notice: Do not type health data, identity numbers or bank accounts into the conversation.

confirm.title: Needs your confirmation
confirm.executing: It was started by an earlier request. Refresh the page shortly to see the result.

draft.title: I prepared a draft
draft.hint: Review it on its real page and submit it yourself. Nothing is sent before that.

limits.monthly: Your company reached its Liwan AI message limit for this month.
limits.run: This request stopped because it exceeded the allowed number of steps.
limits.timeout: The request took longer than allowed.
limits.balanceEmpty: The assistant's prepaid balance is used up, so it starts no new conversations until the balance is topped up.
limits.spendCeiling: Your organization reached the monthly assistant spending ceiling its administrator set.
limits.outputTokens: This request stopped: it reached the answer length allowed for one request.
limits.inputTokens: This request stopped at your organization's input-token ceiling for one request.
limits.consentRequired: The assistant is off until a system administrator signs the AI use acknowledgement.
limits.tenantKeyMissing: Your organization chose to run the assistant on its own key, and no key has been added yet.
limits.perUser: You used the monthly assistant messages your administrator set.
limits.assistMonthly: Your company reached this month's limit for the setup and help assistants.

errors.unavailable: Liwan AI is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.provider: Could not reach the AI model. Try again later.
errors.decide: Could not save your decision. Try again.
errors.auditFailed: The action was done but logging it failed.
errors.resumeFailed: The action was done but the assistant could not finish its reply.

history.title: Recent conversations

rename.label: Conversation name
rename.invalid: The name is 1 to {max} characters with no line breaks.

history.privacy: Your conversations are private. The assistant only sees what you may see.

now.title: In this page now
now.empty: Nothing needs your attention on this page.

settings.title: AI
settings.description: The AI provider, its use acknowledgement, how long conversations are kept, and this month's use.

provider.title: Provider
provider.hint: Who runs the assistant for your organization.

mode.label: How the assistant runs
mode.platformHint: LiwanOS runs it within your plan limits.
mode.tenant_keyHint: It runs on your organization's account with the provider, which pays the cost. Message limits still apply.

key.title: Your organization's key
key.hint: The key is never shown after it is saved; only its last four characters are.
key.baseUrlHint: The https address of an OpenAI-compatible service, for example https://api.example.com/v1.
key.baseUrlInvalid: The address must start with https:// and name a public website, without a port, login or query.
key.baseUrlNotPublic: This address points to a private or internal server. Use the provider's public address.
key.modelHint: The model name as the provider writes it.
key.valueHint: Type a new key to replace the saved one.
key.removeHint: If the assistant runs on your organization's key, it stops until a new key is added.

consent.title: Use acknowledgement
consent.hint: The assistant does not run for your organization until an authorized user signs this acknowledgement, whatever the provider.
consent.requiredHint: The assistant is off for your organization until this acknowledgement is signed.
consent.accept: I have read this acknowledgement and accept it on behalf of the organization
consent.revokeHint: The assistant stops at once for every user of the organization until the acknowledgement is signed again.

retention.title: Conversation retention
retention.hint: Conversations older than this are deleted at the next nightly cleanup.
retention.label: Days
retention.leaverHint: Their memory is deleted at once, their conversations after this period. {min} to {max}; zero means at once.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.hint: Lets the assistant search company records and answer from them.
knowledge.enabledHint: The assistant searches company records and shows each employee only what they can already read.
knowledge.rebuildHint: Every record is indexed again from scratch in the background; complete results may take a little while to return.

usage.title: This month's use
usage.hint: {month}. Counts only; no conversation text is shown.

policy.title: Assistant policy
policy.hint: Limits for every employee, within your plan limits.

perUser.label: Messages per employee each month
perUser.hint: Zero means only your plan limit applies.

inputTokens.label: Input tokens per request
inputTokens.hint: A ceiling so one huge prompt cannot spend the quota and the cost. Zero means no limit of your own.

external.label: Contact with outside parties
external.draft_onlyHint: The assistant prepares the message on the channel page; the employee sends it.
external.approveHint: The assistant sends the message after the employee approves it in the conversation.

agents.title: Agents
agents.empty: No enabled application has an agent.
agents.readOnlyHint: The agent reads; it changes nothing and prepares no drafts.
agents.rolesHint: Leave empty for everyone who holds the assistant permission.
agents.memoryHint: The agent saves short notes about the employee's style and proposes notes about the company's identity.

companyMemory.title: Company identity
companyMemory.hint: Notes about the company's style and terminology that the assistant proposes and uses only after you approve them.
companyMemory.full: The company already has the most approved notes (20). Delete one before approving another.

memory.title: My memory
memory.description: Notes the assistant keeps about how you work and what you prefer, to serve you better. Only you see them, and they hold no copies of records.
memory.empty: The assistant has not saved any note about you yet.
memory.deleteAllTitle: Delete everything the assistant remembers about you?

setup.banner: Setup assistant: it proposes your applications' settings for your line of business and applies nothing without your approval.

help.banner: Help assistant: answers "how do I...?" questions from the LiwanOS guide. It does not read your company's data and changes nothing.

helpStarters.employee: How do I add a new employee?
helpStarters.project: How do I create a new project?
helpStarters.role: How do I give a user a role?
